raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44191.

`POST /hicache/storage-backend/clear` performs a destructive operation
(deleting every regular file in the persistent HiCache backend directory)
but was only guarded by `@auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL)` with no
explicit admin-key check. On a deployment configured with only `--api-key`
(no `--admin-api-key`), any ordinary inference client could erase the
persistent hierarchical cache storage with a single unauthenticated-feeling
request (the issue's reproducer gets HTTP 200 with a plain user API key).

The sibling endpoints for the same backend already treat this as
administrator-only: `PUT /hicache/storage-backend` (attach) and
`DELETE /hicache/storage-backend` (detach) both refuse when the server was
started without `--admin-api-key`. Notably, the `--admin-api-key` help text
(`python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/fields/serving.py`) already lists
`/hicache/storage-backend/clear` as an example of a sensitive management
endpoint — the code just didn't enforce it.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py` — `clear_hicache_storage_backend`
  now returns the shared "requires admin API key" error response when the
  server was started without `--admin-api-key`, mirroring the attach/detach
  endpoints (same call, per the codebase's FIXME convention of simulating
  ADMIN_FORCE until the auth wiring is refactored).
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_auth_levels.py` — new
  `TestHiCacheClearAdminGuard` (CPU): with no admin key configured the
  endpoint returns 400 and never calls `clear_hicache_storage`; with an
  admin key configured it delegates and returns 200.
- `test/registered/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_decode_radix_cache.py`
  — `TestDisaggregationDecodeRadixHiCacheFileBackend` now launches with
  `--admin-api-key` and sends the bearer header on the `/clear` and
  `/flush_cache` calls (both are admin-gated once a key is configured).

## Tests

- New CPU unit tests added; they run in CI (`register_cpu_ci`, same file).
- Local verification here (no GPU / no full deps on this machine, so the
  import-time unit test could not be executed locally): an AST harness
  extracted the real `clear_hicache_storage_backend` function from
  `http_server.py` and executed it against stub collaborators —
  admin key unset → 400 + storage NOT cleared; admin key set → 200 +
  storage cleared. PASS.
- End-to-end HTTP verification against a live server (the issue's
  curl reproducer) was not possible on this machine; CI maintainers' run
  is requested.
- Audit: `ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037`, `ruff format --check`,
  `python3 -m py_compile`, and `git diff --check` all pass on the touched
  files; no added line over 88 cols.

@@ -1090,7 +1090,14 @@ async def list_external_corpora():
 @app.api_route("/hicache/storage-backend/clear", methods=["POST"])
 @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL)
 async def clear_hicache_storage_backend():
-    """Clear the hierarchical cache storage backend."""
+    """Clear the hierarchical cache storage backend.
+
+    Only allowed when an admin API key is configured (mirrors the
+    attach/detach endpoints for the same backend).
+    """
+    if not get_serving().admin_api_key:
+        return _admin_api_key_missing_response()
+
     ret = await _global_state.tokenizer_manager.clear_hicache_storage()
     return Response(
         content="Hierarchical cache storage backend cleared.\n",

@@ -144,7 +144,12 @@ class TestDisaggregationDecodeRadixCacheMooncake(
     "Mooncake is required for decode radix cache disaggregation coverage.",
 )
 class TestDisaggregationDecodeRadixHiCacheFileBackend(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    # POST /hicache/storage-backend/clear (and /flush_cache) require the admin
+    # API key (see issue #44191); generate/health stay unauthenticated.
+    _admin_api_key = "test-admin-key"
     extra_prefill_args = [
+        "--admin-api-key",
+        "test-admin-key",
         "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
         "--hicache-ratio",
         "1.2",
@@ -186,13 +191,14 @@ def tearDownClass(cls):
         os.environ.pop("SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_STORAGE_DIR", None)
         shutil.rmtree(cls.hicache_dir, ignore_errors=True)
 
-    def _post_ok(self, url):
-        response = requests.post(url, timeout=60)
+    def _post_ok(self, url, admin=False):
+        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._admin_api_key}"} if admin else None
+        response = requests.post(url, timeout=60, headers=headers)
         response.raise_for_status()
 
     def _flush_memory_cache(self):
-        self._post_ok(f"{self.prefill_url}/flush_cache?timeout=30")
-        self._post_ok(f"{self.decode_url}/flush_cache?timeout=30")
+        self._post_ok(f"{self.prefill_url}/flush_cache?timeout=30", admin=True)
+        self._post_ok(f"{self.decode_url}/flush_cache?timeout=30", admin=True)
 
     def _generate(self, input_ids, output_len):
         output = asyncio.run(
@@ -220,7 +226,7 @@ def _sample_token_ids(self, input_len, output_len, num_prompts=1):
         ]
 
     def test_decode_hicache_file_backend_l3_reuses_decode_output_after_flush(self):
-        self._post_ok(f"{self.decode_url}/hicache/storage-backend/clear")
+        self._post_ok(f"{self.decode_url}/hicache/storage-backend/clear", admin=True)
         self._flush_memory_cache()
 
         num_rounds = 5

@@ -1,5 +1,9 @@
+import asyncio
 import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch
 
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import app
 from sglang.srt.utils.auth import (
     _get_auth_level_from_app_and_scope,
@@ -42,5 +46,37 @@ def test_state_mutating_endpoints_require_admin_api_key(self):
                 self.assertTrue(self._decide(path, "Bearer admin-secret").allowed)
 
 
+class TestHiCacheClearAdminGuard(CustomTestCase):
+    """POST /hicache/storage-backend/clear must refuse when the server was
+    started without --admin-api-key (issue #44191: an ordinary API key could
+    otherwise erase the persistent hierarchical cache backend)."""
+
+    def _call_clear_endpoint(self, admin_api_key):
+        serving = MagicMock()
+        serving.admin_api_key = admin_api_key
+        global_state = MagicMock()
+        global_state.tokenizer_manager.clear_hicache_storage = AsyncMock(
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(success=True, message="")
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(http_server, "get_serving", return_value=serving),
+            patch.object(http_server, "_global_state", global_state),
+        ):
+            return asyncio.run(http_server.clear_hicache_storage_backend()), (
+                global_state.tokenizer_manager.clear_hicache_storage
+            )
+
+    def test_clear_refuses_without_admin_api_key(self):
+        resp, clear_mock = self._call_clear_endpoint(admin_api_key=None)
+        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 400)
+        self.assertIn("admin API key", resp.body.decode())
+        clear_mock.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_clear_delegates_with_admin_api_key_configured(self):
+        resp, clear_mock = self._call_clear_endpoint(admin_api_key="admin-secret")
+        clear_mock.assert_called_once_with()
+        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
